title: The Quiet Between
logline: A young cartographer returns to a coastal town where memories are recorded in the changing shape of the landscape.
player_fantasy: Read a living world, navigate difficult relationships and reshape paths by choosing what to remember.

creative_direction.visual_identity: Painterly 3D with layered translucent mineral surfaces, weather-shaped silhouettes and hand-authored light gradients.

mechanics.name: Tide Mapping
mechanics.story_purpose: The player draws temporary routes by aligning remembered versions of the coastline.
mechanics.prior_art_notes: Requires a prior-art review before novelty claims.

frameforge.cinematic_style: painterly intimate close-ups and restrained environmental spectacle
